items.caption: 備 in a Shuowen seal-script redraw. The form illustrates the received dictionary analysis of the graph as 人 with 𤰈 serving as a sound element; the latter is also interpreted as an arrow container.
items.alt: Black seal-script form of 備, with a tall left element and a dense, angular structure on the right.
items.selection_reason: The visible form is legible and matches the seal-script redraw identified in the source. It illustrates the received 備 analysis relevant to the proposed person-and-container scene, while the graph’s sound role remains a transmitted interpretation.

limitations.text: This seal-script form is a dictionary-style redraw, not a dated inscription witness. The available evidence does not establish its place in a chronological sequence or independently verify the historical pronunciation behind the proposed sound role.
